description: Configuration for executing bounded local commands/scripts as workers (Researcher or simple Critic modes only). Output is always raw text/stdout; Orchestrator must normalize + validate.

capture.artifacts: any files written to a designated temp dir for the request

forbidden: any command that would mutate source outside a declared (and for this runtime, normally empty) edit scope
result_delivery: Write full raw output (stdout+stderr+exit+metadata) as a single .json or .txt file into agent_collab/inbox/local-script/raw/<request_id>.raw.json. Never attempt to parse into worker_summary or write handoffs/state.
notes: This runtime intentionally fails the edit_code and final_integration_critic safety floors. It is useful for 'run this test script and give me the log' or 'grep the repo for X and summarize' style bounded jobs.
